instruction: A dry dock cradling a brass submarine: a riveted hull with a bulbous viewport nose and open top hatch, wooden support cradles, a gantry crane overhead with chains, barrels and crates of parts, a welding station with sparks, ladders against the hull, portholes glowing, a sea gate holding back water at the dock end, and gulls on the crane arm.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Brass Submarine Dry Dock. A dry dock cradling a brass submarine: a riveted hull with a bulbous viewport nose and open top hatch, wooden support cradles, a gantry crane overhead with chains, barrels and crates of parts, a welding station with sparks, ladders against the hull, portholes glowing, a sea gate holding back water at the dock end, and gulls on the crane arm. Style: nautical steampunk. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
